title: The Market Square Feast
transcript: Good morning from the market square. The food festival is now open, and there's plenty of room to spread out. If you're planning to try several stalls, you can get your tasting tokens at the blue tent by the entrance. You'll find a chalkboard next to each stall listing what's in the dishes. The stallholders are happy to answer questions about ingredients, even when there's a queue. If you've brought young children, the picnic tables behind the bakery are a handy place to sit down together. A quick update on the afternoon programme. The bread making demonstration is still going ahead at the advertised time, but we've moved it indoors to the assembly room because of the wind. Finally, when you've finished eating, please bring any borrowed plates to the return station beside the exit.

questions.explanation: 品尝代币可以在入口旁的蓝色帐篷领取。
每个摊位旁的黑板都列出了菜品的用料。

questions.prompt: Family seating behind the bakery: picnic ____
questions.explanation: 面包店后面的野餐桌方便带小孩的家庭坐在一起。

questions.prompt: What has changed about the bread making demonstration?
options: It will begin later in the afternoon.
It will include a tasting session.
questions.explanation: 由于有风，面包制作演示改到室内举行。

questions.prompt: Where should visitors take borrowed plates?
options: To the stall that served their food
To the return station beside the exit
To the washing area behind the bakery
questions.answer: To the return station beside the exit
questions.explanation: 用餐后，借用的餐盘要送到出口旁的归还处。
